Strategy: Use the winning band only when at least four bins are open, so the band chooses among real options; with fewer bins, Best Fit decides. It may help by applying the band where choice exists, but may fail if four bins are rarely open at once.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 4 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
